Why Clubs and Schools Buy Teamwear Direct

A teamwear supplier in the UK is almost always a reseller. They take your badge, send it to a factory in Pakistan, China or Portugal, and add a margin for handling it. That is a legitimate service - but if your club has a committee that can approve a mockup and a sizing list, you do not need it.

We are the factory those orders end up at. Ordering direct means one approval loop instead of two, a physical sample before bulk, and DDP delivery so the quote is the landed cost. Minimums start at 15 kits per design, which suits a single side, a school house or a social league. Try a trial order first if you would rather see the quality before committing the season's budget.

Questions

What is the minimum order for custom teamwear?

15 kits per design for matchday kit, 20 pieces for training wear and tracksuits, and 50 pieces for club hoodies and polos with a 20-piece trial option. Sizes mix freely within each run.

Can one order cover several teams in the club?

Yes. Several sides can share one pattern with different colourways, and every colourway counts toward the same order rather than starting a new minimum - which is how most multi-team clubs and schools buy.

Do you make school sports kit as well as club kit?

Yes - PE kit, house colours, team kit and leavers' hoodies, produced from the same artwork approval and sized from junior through adult in one run.

How much does custom teamwear cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours. Our published pricing page lists full sublimated kits from $20.00 per set at 15 sets and embroidered polos from $13.00 at 50 pieces, falling 10-40% at higher volumes.

How long does a teamwear order take?

Design mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 2-3 weeks for kit and 3-4 for outerwear, then express DDP delivery in 3-7 days.
